newsitem.title: DUBAI: Britain's Prince Charles to visit Saudi Arabia.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles to visit Saudi Arabia.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles will travel to Saudi Arabia on Wednesday for a two-day visit to meet senior Saudi princes and businessmen, the British embassy in Riyadh said on Tuesday.
The Prince of Wales is also due to visit Saudi Arabia's consultative Shura Council and meet with members of the British community in the kingdom, the embassy said in a statement.
Prince Charles recently made a tour of Saudi Arabia's Gulf Arab neighbours Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar.
